Viêm Gan B
Viêm gan B is a liver infection caused by the Hepatitis B virus (HBV).

Virus Viêm Gan B (HBV)
Virus Viêm Gan B (HBV) is the virus that causes Viêm gan B.

Vàng Da
Vàng Da is a symptom associated with Viêm gan B.

Mệt Mỏi
Mệt Mỏi is a symptom associated with Viêm gan B.

Buồn Nôn
Buồn Nôn is a symptom associated with Viêm gan B.

Đau Bụng
Đau Bụng is a symptom associated with Viêm gan B.

Tenofovir
Tenofovir is an antiviral drug used to treat chronic Viêm gan B.

Viêm Gan B Mãn Tính
Viêm Gan B Mãn Tính is a chronic form of Viêm gan B.

Suy Thận
Suy Thận is a potential side effect of Tenofovir.

Loãng Xương
Loãng Xương is a potential side effect of Tenofovir.

Gan
Gan is an organ that is infected by Viêm gan B.

Abdominal Pain
Abdominal pain is a severe symptom experienced by the patient.<SEP>A symptom presented by the patient.

Diabetic Ketoacidosis
Diabetic Ketoacidosis, also known as DKA, is a severe complication of diabetes.<SEP>The subject of the case study, a severe complication of diabetes.

Fruity Breath Odor
Fruity breath odor is a symptom, characterized by an acetone smell, observed during a physical exam.<SEP>A finding revealed by physical exam.

Hyperglycemia
Hyperglycemia, or high blood glucose, is a lab finding.<SEP>A finding shown by lab results.

Hypokalemia
Hypokalemia, or low potassium, is a potential side effect that can be caused by Insulin.<SEP>A condition caused by insulin, requiring potassium levels to be monitored.

Insulin
Insulin is a hormone and drug used to lower blood sugar.<SEP>A substance administered via infusion that causes hypokalemia.

Insulin Infusion
Insulin infusion is a treatment involving the continuous administration of insulin.<SEP>A treatment component for Diabetic Ketoacidosis.

IV Fluids
IV fluids are an aggressive treatment administered intravenously.<SEP>An aggressive treatment component used for Diabetic Ketoacidosis.

Kussmaul Respirations
Kussmaul respirations are a deep, labored breathing pattern observed during a physical exam.<SEP>A finding revealed by physical exam.

Lab Results
Lab results are diagnostic tests used to analyze blood and other samples for medical findings.<SEP>Diagnostic test findings that showed hyperglycemia and metabolic acidosis.

Metabolic Acidosis
Metabolic acidosis is a lab finding indicating an imbalance in the body's acid-base balance.<SEP>A finding shown by lab results.

Nausea
Nausea is a severe symptom experienced by the patient.

Normal Saline
Normal Saline is a type of IV fluid used in treatment.<SEP>A specific type of IV fluid used in treatment.

Potassium Levels
Potassium levels are monitored to detect potential side effects of treatment.

Type 1 Diabetes
Type 1 Diabetes is a chronic condition that can lead to Diabetic Ketoacidosis.<SEP>A pre-existing condition of the patient mentioned in the case study.

Vomiting
Vomiting is a severe symptom experienced by the patient.<SEP>A symptom presented by the patient.

Physical Exam
A physical exam is a medical assessment method used to identify symptoms and signs.<SEP>A diagnostic procedure that revealed Kussmaul respirations and fruity breath odor.

Patient
A 25-year-old individual with Type 1 Diabetes mentioned in the case study.

Severe Nausea
A symptom presented by the patient.

Potassium Levels Monitoring
A procedure required to monitor potassium levels due to insulin causing hypokalemia.
